title: Something for the Weekend
content:
Donegal mix master Colpey Calling selects his new Track of the Week, as well as the Best Track You’ve Never Heard.

Track of the Week

Vermont – “Elektron” (Prins Thomas version) (2014)

Vermont’s ambient electronic release earlier this year is a personal favourite, so to finally get a great artist to give them a revamp for the dance floor was always going to get me excited and Prins Thomas delivers! Delve in and check out the rest of the EP!

Best Track You’ve Never Heard

Grauzone – “Film 2” (1982)

This is one of my go-to tracks when I am struggling with a dance floor. Takes them by surprise and gets people on their feet instantly. An absolute bomb of a track! Enjoy! Love it! Grauzone at their best!
